verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a web JavaScript tag/snippet and a React integration that are '100% compatible with Segment API', which implies the track/identify/page spec; identify events are referenced explicitly by Profile Builder. Backend collection is through an HTTP API rather than a dedicated server SDK, and one community user reports collecting CLI telemetry easily. Missing for 10: any evidence of official mobile SDKs, official server-side language SDKs (beyond the raw HTTP API), and first-party documentation of the tracking spec itself (track/page method definitions).
